sesiones.title: WhatsApp sessions
sesiones.description: WhatsApp numbers connected to the company. Your plan sets the quota: once you hit the max, you cannot open another session.

plan_limit.max_whatsapp_sessions: You reached your plan's WhatsApp session limit. Upgrade your plan to add more.

sesiones.search_placeholder: Search by channel, session or number...

empty.no_records_description: Create the first WhatsApp session. If your plan allows only one, the button locks after you create it.
empty.no_results_description: No session matches the current filters.

form.description_create: Register a WhatsApp channel. Then click Connect on the row to scan the QR.
form.description_edit: Update the display name and linked location.
form.section_basic_hint_create: Identify this session. The internal id is generated from the company slug.
form.section_basic_hint_edit: The internal id does not change. You can adjust the alias and location.

fields.sede_hint: On plans with more than one session you can link each number to a branch.
fields.auto_reconnect_hint: If the session drops, the connector will try to bring it back.

connect.title: Link WhatsApp
connect.description: Scan the QR to connect “{{name}}” as a linked device.
connect.scan: Open WhatsApp on the phone and scan this code
connect.steps: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device.
connect.qr_error: Could not fetch the QR code.
connect.start_error: Could not start the session. Check the OpenWA configuration.
connect.network_error: Network error while requesting the QR.
connect.not_configured: The WhatsApp connector is not configured on the server. An admin must set OPENWA_API_URL and OPENWA_API_KEY.

disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp
disconnect.description: You are about to unlink channel {{name}}. The phone will stop sending and receiving on this channel until you scan a QR again.

delete.title: Delete session
delete.description: You are about to delete channel {{name}}. One plan slot will become free. This cannot be undone from here.

toast.load_error: Could not load the session list.

envios.title: Scheduled sends
envios.description: WhatsApp drip queue. Campaigns and reminders go out across the send window and plan quota; agent replies stay instant.
envios.empty_description: When you schedule a campaign or reminder, each destination will appear here until the worker sends it.

empty.no_records_description: No drip messages yet. Agent replies do not go through this queue.
empty.no_results_description: No sends match the current filter.

historial.title: Send history
historial.description: Review what already went out: dates, recipients and delivery result.
historial.empty_description: The send log will appear here when the queue starts dispatching messages.
